in_hebrew.name: Stanko
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Stanko הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic word ‘stanku’, meaning ‘garland’ or ‘wreath’. In the Middle Ages, Stanko was a popular name for boys born into noble families, symbolizing prosperity and wealth.
